simulator: TIAGo PRO Jazzy / Gazebo Harmonic source kit environment
localization: simulation truth odometry, identity map to odom
reset: Between runs, stopped Nav2, set Gazebo tiago_pro pose to x=-2.65728,y=1.35,z=.02,yaw=pi/2, restarted Nav2. Measured starts in reports agree within 2e-8 m and 1e-8 rad.
scope: One successful 0.8 m goal per final profile; no claim of general navigation reliability or corridor traversal.
tuning_note: Initial grids lacked exact zero x velocity and permitted small creep below the policy epsilon. After correction, path-heading scoring near the short goal conflicted with final approach. Releasing path-heading constraints inside .25m while retaining the body cone allowed success. Failed trials were aborted by the operator after progress failures.
